utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — keep me posted, and I’ll help piece it together once something solid comes through.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll keep checking and share the first solid update I get.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, sorry — I’m still a bit behind on the details. Just let me know what’s most urgent when you’re there, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Noah — I’ll need the final time and location first, since I like to have the plan set. If you get those details, please send them along as soon as you can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll pass along the final time and location as soon as I have them. Thanks for keeping me on track.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s keep that driveway crack by the east side gate at the top of the list — I’ll send over the exact details so everyone stays aligned.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Keep it simple and send the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll send the simple details for the driveway crack by the east side gate right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks. I’ll send what I know once I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, sounds good — send it over when you’ve got it, and I’ll get on that driveway crack by the east side gate first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks. I’ll send it over once I’m certain.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m on it — as soon as the final repair drive details are set, I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good. I need the organizer’s name and the exact meetup spot before anyone shows up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll get the organizer’s name and exact meetup spot and pass them along as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds fine to me — I’ll follow your lead and just hope I don’t muddle the timing again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s all right, Oren — I’ll keep the timing in my notes, and if you hear anything different, just let me know so I can update them carefully.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thank you, Cleo — that helps a lot. I’ll let you know if I hear any changes, and I’ll stick with your notes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll start with the biggest safety issue first and work down the list. Just tell me where to show up and I’ll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.speaker: Gus
